PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.

4. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.

5. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.

6. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

7. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

9. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.

10. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Introduction to Entrepreneurship 8  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Hardware and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Entrepreneurship 8 5.2 Production Unit 10 5.3 Financial Goals 10 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
